R10 — source-bound placement oracle for changed-length members (read-only; 2026-09-20, Priority 1B).

For the league-logo package member of each measured gen7 chain (handoff 02 rev. 2 of 2026-09-19), this probe computes — without
writing anything under X:/H: — the exact words a size-changing replacement must patch and the SHA-256 of the resulting files, for
defined replacement inputs, so the developer's planner can be tested against an independent oracle:

  * inner BIGF re-plan (handoff 02 §4.2) on every one of the 129 measured packages: identity (T' = T must reproduce the package
    byte-for-byte) and growth variants T' = T + N zero bytes for N in {1, 63, 64} → expected package SHA-256 + patched table words;
  * BIG4 + `.bh` outer placement (§4.3) on the 9 BIG4 archives: fit-in-slot (N = slack), append-and-retarget and ordered reflow
    (N = slack + 64), each as (patch list, expected .big SHA-256, expected .bh SHA-256);
  * EB 0x00000400 outer placement (§4.1, the `stage.rs` semantics) on the 7 EB archives of the measured chains: fit / append;
  * NHL 07 `boot.big` embedded `.bh` copies: member identities and the loose-file equality;
  * unknown-field census: BIGF index trailer (8 bytes after the last name), BIG4 index trailer, `.bh` trailer, EB row `w4`,
    pre-member gap bytes.

Replacement inputs are *defined*, not encoded: payload' = stock payload ++ N zero bytes (N ≥ 1), declared length S + N. (No stock
member carries bytes after its RefPack terminator — handoff 02 §3.1 — so this is a test construction, not an observed shape.)
Hashes are computed by streaming the source with the patches applied in memory.

Usage: python r10_placement_oracle.py <out.json> [--skip-hash] [--only bigf|big4|eb|nhl07|fields]
